inspiration: Scheduled world-boss window: a base date and a period set the cycle; a start and end offset define the window; the appearance time is a random point inside that window (src/l1j/server/server/model/L1BossCycle.java lines 215-258; data/xml/Cycle/BossCycle.xml line 13). Keep the daily window with a random appearance; change it with a sighting hint before the window and a small daily jitter.

Defect in the window code (keep the idea, fix the defect): the target search steps the base date one period at a time, so the cost grows with elapsed time (L1BossCycle.java lines 215-232). Fix: compute the cycle in closed form from elapsed minutes modulo the period.

Defect in the window code: calcSpawnTime draws a new random offset on every call (L1BossCycle.java line 256), so the same boss can report a different appearance on each call. Fix: draw once per cycle and store it.

Pack alert by family tag: each creature row carries a family id and an agro-family mode; a link search over known creatures links the same family (mode 1) or all family members (other modes), and mob group members are linked too (src/l1j/server/server/model/Instance/L1NpcInstance.java lines 373-389). Keep the family tag and the mode field; change it to a hate list with a cap of 3 attackers per the Frankendom rulings.

Defect in the pack alert: the base setLink body is empty (L1NpcInstance.java lines 370-371). Overrides exist in L1MonsterInstance.java line 207 and L1GuardianInstance.java line 97 (not read). Fix: keep the link logic in one place, not in each subclass.

Creature traits as columns on one row: tamable, picks up items, digests items, ranged, agro flags and family flags sit on the npc table row (db/l1jdb_m10.sql lines 1566-1582). Keep traits as data columns; change how they show, as silhouette marks rather than text.

Rest-zone regen as data: castle, hotel, house and mother-tree rest areas each have a regen multiplier separate from the base rate (config/rates.properties: RateHpRegen at line 7, RateHpCastle at line 10; hotel, house and mother-tree values follow in the same file, not line-checked). Keep the per-zone multiplier; show rest zones with a campfire glow instead of numbers.

Skill and drop rows per creature: mobskill rows and droplist rows key on the creature (db/l1jdb_m10.sql lines 1514, 656). Keep the rows keyed on creature; add a visible telegraph for each creature skill and a loot ceremony for drops.

briefs.label: Window boss
briefs.why: A daily window with a random appearance makes a boss an event people plan around, not a timer they watch.
briefs.keep: daily window; random appearance point inside the window; a fixed base date and period
briefs.change: a sighting hint ten minutes before the window; a small jitter each day so the time is not fixed; a visible countdown in the zone

briefs.label: Pack-alert creature
briefs.why: Family tags let one pull call the pack, which reads well with many-on-one fights.
briefs.keep: a family tag on each creature; a mode field that says who joins; pack members link as a group
briefs.change: a cap of three attackers per the Frankendom rulings; a hate list instead of a link flag; a visible alert ring on the pack

briefs.label: Rest-ring shrine
briefs.why: A per-zone regen multiplier gives a clear reason to stop in a rest zone.
briefs.keep: a regen multiplier per rest-zone type, separate from the base rate
briefs.change: a campfire glow and a safe ring instead of a number; the glow brightens with the regen rate

briefs.label: Trait-marked creature
briefs.why: A creature that carries a few traits reads as different from the others at a glance.
briefs.keep: traits stored as flags on one creature row (tamable, item pickup, ranged)
briefs.change: traits shown as silhouette marks (a crest, a tail, a carried item) instead of text; each trait has its own colour
